execution_contract.selection: structured deterministic predicates; lists above are reviewed label concepts, not executable regex or guaranteed code mappings; map verified code/label to canonical concept before use
execution_contract.unknown: conditional or unknown, never false by default
execution_contract.precedence: 07 safety > 03 score > 04 baseline and 05 interpretation; 06 quality qualifies evidence but cannot clear safety
execution_contract.rule_ids: stable IDs; references in outputs include rule version and evidence IDs

PS03-V4.1.title: Hackathon PS03 requirements and frozen V4.1 architecture

rules.action: Use component bands in 03_news2_scoring.md; score only eligible measurements.
rules.limitations: Not full NEWS2; do not map subtotal to RCP escalation thresholds.

rules.action: Apply Scale 2 bands; oxygen status required for scores above target.
rules.limitations: COPD alone not sufficient; unknown oxygen status is not room air.

rules.action: Use prior eligible samples only; compare before updating; freeze on concern.
rules.limitations: No historical or simulator value is an established baseline.

rules.action: Evaluate absolute baseline deviation and trend; apply 04 and 05.
rules.limitations: Activity and medications can influence HR; no diagnosis.

rules.action: Evaluate sustained RR increase or decrease and oxygenation evidence.
rules.limitations: RR zero may be genuine or artifact; verify urgently.

rules.action: Evaluate downward deviation and trend with quality and applicable scale.
rules.limitations: Normal HR/RR cannot rule out hypoxemia.

rules.action: Evaluate sustained thermal deviation and HR trend.
rules.limitations: Fever alone does not establish infection.

rules.action: Use respiratory and oxygenation evidence together; contextual concern rule in 05.
rules.limitations: History not evidence of active disease; no automatic Scale 2.

rules.action: Use HR, RR and SpO2 evidence; consider cardiac recovery context.
rules.limitations: No diagnosis of heart failure exacerbation or ischemia from vitals alone.

rules.action: Add conditional possible blunted HR response note; if current use verified, apply contextual interpretation in 05.
rules.limitations: Do not infer current use, adherence or reduce NEWS2 score.

rules.action: Evaluate temperature and cardiorespiratory trends together.
rules.limitations: No diagnosis of recurrent infection or sepsis.

rules.action: Retrieve approved restrictions and recovery plan if documented.
rules.limitations: Encounter reason is not proof of surgery; no inferred restrictions.

rules.action: Consider concurrent oxygenation decline and HR/RR change as supportive evidence; pass evidence reference to manifest.
rules.limitations: Association not causation; equation coefficients not finalized.

rules.action: Consider simultaneous temperature and HR increase; pass evidence reference.
rules.limitations: Relationship may be modified by other factors; no fixed coefficient.

rules.action: Apply 06 joint artifact detector; technical alert; assess remaining reliable signals.
rules.limitations: Pattern alone not proof of artifact; preserve unresolved safety concern.

rules.action: Mark unavailable, never score as zero; use 06 monitoring policy.
Apply 07 safety priority before any model output.
rules.limitations: Prototype escalation policy requires clinical approval.

rules.action: Only present authorized plan and reminders; unresolved concerns block autonomous progression.
rules.limitations: No medication or exercise changes without clinician authorization.
